usage: cox host add [-h] --ssh SSH --capacity CAPACITY [--weight WEIGHT]
                    [--capabilities CAPABILITIES]
                    name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ssh SSH
  --capacity CAPACITY   lanes the host may run at once
  --weight WEIGHT       share of new placements
  --capabilities CAPABILITIES
                        comma-separated, e.g. go,rust
